newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: BRL Hardy makes U.S. marketing changes.
newsitem.headline: BRL Hardy makes U.S. marketing changes.

text.p: Australian wine producer BRL Hardy Ltd said on Wednesday two key marketing appointments to its United States operations would help it maintain strong export growth.
BRL said in a statement that Hugh Matthews, who had spearheaded the company's first move into the U.S. in 1994, would take up the Australian based position of trading director for the U.S.
Ken Blount, previously involved with the U.S. premium wine producer Brown-Forman Corp, would take up the Washington DC-position as president of BRL Hardy United States, it said.
BRL said it aimed to maintain the strong growth of its bottled wine sales to the U.S. which rose 96 percent in 1996, and the appointments would help achieve its forecast for 1997.
